response.grain: One row per party-activity record: a single party (party_activity.party_id, with party_activity.abn where supplied) in a single role (party_activity.party_role_category / party_activity.party_role) on a single IP right application (party_activity.ip_right_type + party_activity.application_number). Application-level columns repeat for every party row on the same application, so a row is neither one application nor one party.

groups.name: party_identity
groups.purpose: Identity and classification of the party named on the record: party key, name, party type, and the ABN where supplied. Party type is a party classification, not a legal form.

groups.name: party_role_on_application
groups.purpose: The role the party holds on the application (applicant, patentee, agent, opponent, mortgagee etc.) and the validity window of that party-role record. These describe the party-role record, not the application or the business lifecycle.

groups.name: party_address
groups.purpose: Address attributes of the party as recorded on the record: country, state and post code. Post code formats are not uniform and country is not always present.

groups.name: application_identity_and_type
groups.purpose: Identity and classification of the IP right application the party is acting on: application number, IP right type and sub-type. Repeated across party rows of the same application.

groups.name: application_status_and_dates
groups.purpose: Application-level lifecycle: status and the filing, priority, registration, enforceability, retirement and termination dates. These describe the application, not the party or the business.

groups.name: application_description
groups.purpose: The description text attached to the application, with its description type and the application/right-type keys that link it back to the application. At most one description per application.

entity_types.name: party
entity_types.definition: A person or organisation recorded as acting in a role on an IP right application; identified by party_id, with party_type as a party classification only and no legal-form inference.

entity_types.name: ip_application
entity_types.definition: An IP right application identified by ip_right_type plus application_number, carrying its own status, dates and description.

entity_types.name: party_activity
entity_types.definition: The association of one party in one role on one IP right application, with its own validity window (effective_from_date, effective_to_date, is_current).

party.rationale: party_id is the party key; party_name and abn are attributes of the party where supplied. party_type is a party classification, not a legal form, and a personal name must not be used to infer a company legal form or ABN.

ip_application.rationale: The application is identified by its number together with the IP right type; application-level status, dates and description belong to the application, not to the party or business.

party_activity.rationale: The record grain is a party in a role on an application; the same party_id can hold different roles across rows, so the role and application keys are needed alongside the party key.

relationship_types.name: PARTY_ACTS_ON_APPLICATION
relationship_types.definition: A party is recorded in a role on an IP right application, via a party-activity record; the role does not imply ownership, beneficial interest or enforceability.

relationship_types.name: PARTY_ACTIVITY_RECORDS_PARTY
relationship_types.definition: A party-activity record names the party that holds the recorded role.

relationship_types.name: PARTY_ACTIVITY_CONCERNS_APPLICATION
relationship_types.definition: A party-activity record concerns the IP right application identified by its application number and IP right type.

relationship_types.name: APPLICATION_HAS_DESCRIPTION
relationship_types.definition: An IP right application has at most one description record, linked by application number and IP right type.

relationships.rationale: party_activity.party_id is the party key carried on each party-activity row.
party_activity.application_number and party_activity.ip_right_type identify the application the party-role record concerns.

Derived from the party-activity record linking party_id to application_number and ip_right_type; the role (applicant, patentee, agent, opponent, mortgagee) is recorded on the party-activity record and does not imply ownership or enforceability.

application_description.application_number and application_description.ip_right_type link the description to the application; the description table contributes at most one description per application.

cautions: party_activity.abn is frequently blank; absence of an ABN must not be read as absence of a business or as a non-Australian entity.
party_activity.party_name is free text and lower-cased; the same organisation may appear under name variants, and a personal name must not be used to infer a company legal form or an ABN.
party_activity.party_type (organisation/individual) is a party classification, not a company legal form or beneficial-ownership statement.
party_activity.party_id alone does not identify a unique business relationship: the same party_id can hold different roles across rows.
party_activity.state_code, post_code and country_code are party address attributes; post_code formats are not uniform and country_code is not always present.
patent/application status, dates and description describe the application, not the party or the business; a grant or registration date is not a business incorporation date.
party_activity.effective_from_date / effective_to_date / is_current describe the party-role record's validity, not the application's or the business's lifecycle.
The cohort is a patent-prefix subset, not a population sample; no population-level accuracy or completeness claim can be made.
Model-proposed joins were checked on full right tables and missing/ambiguous matches are null, so blank application-level fields may reflect an unmatched join rather than a true absence of data.
application.enforceable_from_date is entirely empty in the observed profile and is retained only as an application-level date column.
